nodes.short_description: Titan Isles is a high-mobility action-adventure shooter where you pilot five unique Exo Suits, each with its own combat style and movement mastery. Upgrade your abilities, battle colossal Titans across the Isles, and play solo or with up to three friends in seamless 4-player co-op.

Titan Isles — динамичный приключенческий шутер, где вы управляете 5 уникальными экзокостюмами со своим стилем боя. Улучшайте способности, сражайтесь с колоссальными титанами на островах и играйте в одиночку или с 3 друзьями в бесшовном кооперативе на 4 игроков.

Titan Isles è uno sparatutto d'azione-avventura ad alta mobilità in cui piloti cinque Exo Suit unici, ciascuno con il proprio stile di combattimento. Potenzia le abilità, affronta Titani colossali sulle isole e gioca da solo o con un massimo di 3 amici in co-op a 4 giocatori.
《Titan Isles》是一款高機動性的動作冒險射擊遊戲。駕駛五套獨特的Exo戰衣，體驗專屬戰鬥方式與移動技巧。升級你的能力，在群島上迎戰巨型泰坦，並支援單人或最多與三位好友進行無縫4人合作。

Titan Isles är en action- och äventyrsskjutare med hög rörlighet där du styr fem unika Exo Suits med egna stridsstilar. Uppgradera dina förmågor, kämpa mot kolossala titaner över öarna och spela solo eller med upp till 3 vänner i sömlöst 4-spelar co-op.

Titan Isles, her biri benzersiz savaş stiline sahip 5 Exo Suit kullandığınız dinamik bir aksiyon-macera nişancı oyunudur. Yeteneklerinizi geliştirin, adalardaki devasa Titanlarla savaşın; tek başınıza veya en fazla 3 arkadaşınızla kesintisiz 4 oyunculu eşli oynayın.

Το Titan Isles είναι ένα shooter δράσης-περιπέτειας υψηλής κινητικότητας όπου πιλοτάρετε πέντε μοναδικές Exo Suits με ξεχωριστό στυλ μάχης. Αναβαθμίστε τις ικανότητές σας, πολεμήστε κολοσσιαίους Τιτάνες στα νησιά και παίξτε μόνοι ή με έως 3 φίλους σε co-op 4 παικτών.

Titan Isles es un juego de acción y aventura de alta movilidad donde pilotas cinco trajes exo únicos con su propio estilo de combate. Mejora tus habilidades, lucha contra titanes colosales por las islas y juega solo o con hasta 3 amigos en cooperativo fluido para 4 jugadores.

Titan Isles on nopeatempoinen toimintaseikkailuräiskintä, jossa ohjaat viittä ainutlaatuista Exo-pukua omine taistelutyyleineen. Päivitä kykyjäsi, taistele valtavia titaaneja vastaan saarilla ja pelaa yksin tai jopa 3 ystävän kanssa saumattomassa 4 pelaajan yhteistyötilassa.

Titan Isles is a high-mobility action-adventure shooter where you pilot five unique Exo Suits, each with its own combat style and movement mastery. Upgrade your abilities, battle colossal Titans across the Isles, and play solo or with up to three friends in seamless 4-player co-op.

Titan Isles ist ein hochmobiler Action-Adventure-Shooter: Steuere fünf einzigartige Exo-Suits mit individuellem Kampfstil. Verbessere deine Fähigkeiten, bekämpfe kolossale Titanen auf den Inseln und spiele solo oder mit bis zu 3 Freunden im nahtlosen 4-Spieler-Koop.

Titan Isles é um jogo de ação e aventura de alta mobilidade onde pilotas cinco Exo Suits únicos com estilos de combate próprios. Melhora as tuas capacidades, combate Titãs colossais nas Ilhas e joga a solo ou com até 3 amigos em modo cooperativo fluido para 4 jogadores.

Titan Isles este un shooter de acțiune și aventură dinamic în care pilotezi cinci costume Exo unice cu propriul stil de luptă. Îmbunătățește-ți abilitățile, înfruntă titani colosali pe insule și joacă solo sau cu până la 3 prieteni în mod cooperativ fluid de 4 jucători.

Titan Isles est un jeu de tir et d'action-aventure ultra-dynamique où vous pilotez cinq Exo Suits uniques au style de combat propre. Améliorez vos capacités, affrontez des Titans colossaux sur les îles et jouez en solo ou jusqu'à 4 en coopération fluide.

Titan Isles es un shooter de acción y aventura de alta movilidad donde pilotas cinco Exo Suits únicos con su propio estilo de combate. Mejora tus habilidades, lucha contra titanes colosales por las islas y juega en solitario o con hasta 3 amigos en cooperativo para 4 jugadores.

Titan Isles é um shooter de ação e aventura de alta mobilidade onde você pilota cinco Exo Suits únicos com estilos próprios de combate. Aprimore suas habilidades, enfrente Titãs colossais pelas ilhas e jogue solo ou com até 3 amigos em um modo cooperativo fluido para 4 jogadores.

Titan Isles er et action-eventyrskytespill med høy mobilitet der du styrer fem unike Exo-drakter med egne kampstiler. Oppgrader evnene dine, kjemp mot kolossale Titans på øyene, og spill alene eller med opptil 3 venner i sømløst 4-spillersamarbeid.
《Titan Isles》是一款高机动性动作冒险射击游戏。驾驶五套独特的Exo战衣，体验专属战斗风格与机动技巧。升级你的能力，在群岛上迎战巨型泰坦，支持单人或最多4人无缝联机合作。
《Titan Isles》是一款高機動性的動作冒險射擊遊戲。駕駛五套獨特的Exo戰衣，體驗專屬戰鬥方式與移動技巧。升級你的能力，在群島上迎戰巨型泰坦，並支援單人或最多與三位好友進行無縫4人合作。

Titan Isles je akční adventura s vysokou pohyblivostí, kde pilotujete pět unikátních exo obleků s vlastním stylem boje a pohybu. Vylepšujte schopnosti, bojujte s kolosálními Titány napříč ostrovy a hrajte sólo nebo až se 3 přáteli v plynulé kooperaci pro 4 hráče.

Titan Isles er et action-adventure skydespil med høj mobilitet, hvor du styrer fem unikke Exo Suits med hver sin kampstil. Opgrader dine evner, bekæmp kolossale titaner på øerne, og spil solo eller med op til 3 venner i problemfrit 4-spiller co-op.

Titan Isles to dynamiczna strzelanka akcji, w której pilotujesz pięć unikalnych kombinezonów Exo o własnym stylu walki. Ulepszaj umiejętności, walcz z kolosalnymi Tytanami na wyspach i graj solo lub nawet z 3 znajomymi w płynnej 4-osobowej kooperacji.
타이탄 아일즈(Titan Isles)는 고유한 전투 스타일과 기동성을 지닌 5종의 엑소 슈트를 조종하는 고기동 액션 어드벤처 슈팅 게임입니다. 능력을 업그레이드하고 거대한 타이탄과 맞서 싸우세요. 솔로 플레이 또는 최대 4인 원활한 협동 플레이를 지원합니다.

Titan Isles is een beweeglijke action-adventure shooter waarin je vijf unieke Exo Suits bestuurt met elk een eigen vechtstijl. Verbeter je vaardigheden, vecht tegen kolossale Titans op de eilanden en speel solo of met maximaal 3 vrienden in naadloze co-op voor 4 spelers.

Titan Isles là game bắn súng hành động phiêu lưu tốc độ cao, nơi bạn điều khiển 5 bộ giáp Exo Suit độc đáo với phong cách chiến đấu riêng. Nâng cấp kỹ năng, hạ gục các Titan khổng lồ trên đảo và chơi solo hoặc cùng tối đa 3 bạn bè trong chế độ co-op 4 người mượt mà.
『Titan Isles』は、独自の戦闘スタイルと機動力を持つ5体のExo Suitを操る高機動アクションADVシューターです。アビリティを強化し、群島で巨大なタイタンに立ち向かおう。ソロはもちろん、最大4人でのシームレスな協力プレイも楽しめます。

nodes.long_description:
# **BATTLE TITANS - WITH FRIENDS OR ALONE**

Set on the broken world of Toska, shattered to ruins by the mysterious awakening of giant Titans, you - the player, are cast into an epic struggle for survival and revenge.

# **USE POWERFUL EXO SUITS**
{1182808979868801}
Before launching into each mission, you’ll choose from one of four Exo Suits, each providing it's own unique traversal equipment and weapons.

# **PLAY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS**
{658737879847254}
The full game can be enjoyed as a single player campaign or you can invite your friends in up-to 4-player co-op.

# **UNCOVER THE SECRETS OF THE TITANS**
{565889143140523}
It's up to you and your team to locate and defeat the Titans, along the way you'll uncover the motivations and secrets behind the existence of the Titans and their destructive attack on the world of Toska.


# **TRAVERSE A PLETHORA OF ENVIRONMENTS**
{1282405879494333}
As you progress, you'll discover the many different biomes that together, form the vibrant world of Titan Isles.
nodes.short_description: Battle swarming robots and colossal machines either alone or with friends across a fractured world of floating islands and breathtaking vistas.

nodes.change_log:
✨ What's New

🚀 Meet Cage, the fifth playable suit. Fly anywhere with an anti-gravity rotors, fire laser guided homing rockets and launch charged Vortex shots.
💎 Supporter Suits are here: each suit now has an optional premium skin you can buy and wear straight away from the suit kiosk.
🗺️ Scrapspine Ridge is a new encounter in Campaign 7. Climb over a giant titan spine rising from an energy sea, cross floating islands and fight through three arenas.
📦 Breakable loot boxes have a fresh new look.
💬 A Join Discord button in the Hub takes you straight to the community.

⚙️ Improvements

⚡ The Hub loads much faster, so you spend far less time waiting in the black.
💥 Enemy shots now burst into smoke where they hit scenery, which makes firefights easier to read and lighter on performance.
🌬️ You now hear the wind rush past you, and it grows louder the faster you run, glide or fly.
⚡ Blink's linked discs now crackle with sound while the energy arc between them is active.
🌐 Multiplayer runs more smoothly thanks to optimisations to how game data is sent between players.

🐛 Bug Fixes

🚪 Fixed some players (rare) being stuck on the health warning screen, unable to start the game, when their room setup was off centre.
🏹 Fixed Hunter's bow sometimes staying drawn after you let go of it.
☕ Mugs in the seasonal Hubs now sync properly, so other players see you pick them up.
🫳 Items no longer fall through tables or the floor when you grab them and let go without pulling.
🎯 Thrown and dropped items now come to rest in the same place for every player.
🧥 Previewed skins and themes you didn't buy no longer stay on your suit after you leave the suit kiosk.
💪 Fixed Hunter's arm jittering.
🐦 The birds flying past in cutscenes can be heard again.
🎨 Fixed flickering text on toggle buttons and wrong colours on the cursor and colour picker.
